title: The Admin Columns plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'HTTP_USER_AGENT'…
description: The Admin Columns plugin for WordPress up to version 7.1.7 is vulnerable to stored cross-site scripting (XSS) via the HTTP_USER_AGENT parameter. This vulnerability arises from insufficient input sanitization and output escaping, allowing unauthenticated attackers to inject malicious scripts that execute when users access affected pages. The issue stems from the sanitization method allowing certain data-* attributes to pass unchecked, enabling payloads to survive and execute in the browser context.
